package_name: Spiti Mysteries (5D) — Gue Mummy & Kunzum Pass

itinerary.day_1: Kaza Local (Drive: Local). Places: Kaza, Key Monastery. Activities: Key Monastery (4,166m); Kaza market; Kibber village evening.
itinerary.day_2: Gue Mummy Village (Drive: 60 km). Places: Gue Mummy Village, Tabo Monastery. Activities: Gue — 500-year-old mummified monk; Spiti desert drive; Tabo monastery murals.
itinerary.day_3: Nako & Kinnaur Entry (Drive: 100 km). Places: Nako Village. Activities: Nako Lake monastery; Hanging valley views; Reckong Peo night.
itinerary.day_4: Return → Chandratal (Drive: 150 km). Places: Kunzum Pass, Chandratal Lake. Activities: Kunzum Pass (4,590m); Chandratal Moon Lake; High-altitude camping.
itinerary.day_5: Depart (Drive: Local). Places: Kaza. Activities: Sunrise over Chandratal; Return to Kaza; Depart Lahaul-Spiti.
